parameters.query:
INSERT INTO loan_products
  (product_name, source, source_url, interest_rate, min_income, min_credit_score,
   max_credit_score, min_age, max_age, employment_status, criteria_text, criteria_hash,
   is_active, last_crawled_at)
VALUES
  ($1, $2, $3,
   NULLIF(NULLIF($4, 'null'), '')::numeric,
   NULLIF(NULLIF($5, 'null'), '')::numeric,
   NULLIF(NULLIF($6, 'null'), '')::int,
   NULLIF(NULLIF($7, 'null'), '')::int,
   NULLIF(NULLIF($8, 'null'), '')::int,
   NULLIF(NULLIF($9, 'null'), '')::int,
   NULLIF(NULLIF($10, 'null'), '')::text[],
   $11, $12, true, now())
ON CONFLICT (product_name, source) DO UPDATE SET
  source_url        = EXCLUDED.source_url,
  interest_rate     = EXCLUDED.interest_rate,
  min_income        = EXCLUDED.min_income,
  min_credit_score  = EXCLUDED.min_credit_score,
  max_credit_score  = EXCLUDED.max_credit_score,
  min_age           = EXCLUDED.min_age,
  max_age           = EXCLUDED.max_age,
  employment_status = EXCLUDED.employment_status,
  criteria_text     = EXCLUDED.criteria_text,
  criteria_hash     = EXCLUDED.criteria_hash,
  is_active         = true,
  last_crawled_at   = now();
